findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed soda nozzle in front self-service area or be soiled with debris. PIC was informed and nozzle was cleaned and sanitized. Ensure soda nozzles are cleaned frequently to avoid accumulation of debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Time as a Public Health Control; procedures & records.
findings.comment: Observed time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods stored ambient on prep table with no proper marking for time as a control. The PIC stated that the employee forgot to label the items with the time control stickers. The tomato and lettuce that were unmarked were discarded. The rest of the produce was properly and clearly marked. Ensure staff are using the time as a control stickers at all times and discarding after 4 hours.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.19(C)(3) Time as a Public Health Control. (C) If time without temperature control is used as the public health control up to a maximum of 6 hours: (3) The FOOD shall be marked or otherwise identified to indicate: (a) The time when the FOOD is removed from 5C (41F) or less cold holding temperature control, and (b) The time that is 6 hours past the point in time when the FOOD is removed from cold holding temperature control.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment, and linens: properly stored, dried, and handled.
findings.comment:
Repeat Violation

Observed bins holding clean equipment and utensils to be soiled with food and debris. PIC was informed and bin was moved to the dish area. Ensure staff are cleaning the bins frequently to avoid accumulation of food debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) Equipment, Utensils, Linens, and Single-Service and Single-Use Articles. (A) Except as specified in (D) of this section, cleaned EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS, laundered LINENS, and SINGLE-SERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES shall be stored: (1) In a clean, dry location; (2) Where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination; and (3) At least 15 cm (6 inches) above the floor.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
Observed several food employees put on new gloves without washing hands in between glove changes. Discussed proper glove use and hand washing technique with PIC and employees during inspection. 

2-301.12: (A) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
Observed baffle of ice machine to be soiled with debris. Clean and sanitize baffle of ice machine. 

4-602.11: (D) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned less than every 4 hours if in storage of food within proper temperatures, food is prepared in refrigerated room, if practice has regulatory approval, or UTENSILS stored in 135F water. (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Utensils, equipment & linens: properly stored, dried, & handled
findings.comment:
Observed containers used to store clean utensils and cookware to be soiled with food debris. Clean and sanitize containers used to store utensils and cookware. 

4-903.11: (A) clean FOOD-CONTACT surfaces shall be stored: in clean, dry location, not exposed to splash or other contamination, and at least 6 inches above floor. (B) clean EQUIPMENT shall be stored in self-draining position that allows air drying, covered or inverted. (D) Items that are kept in closed PACKAGES may be stored below 6 inches if on dollies, pallets, racks, and skids properly designed.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Observed top of fryers to be soiled with food splash and debris. Clean top of fryers. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
Observed ceiling light fixture in dry storage area to be missing a shield. Replace shield of ceiling light fixture. 

6-202.11: Light bulbs shall be shielded, coated or otherwise shatter-resistant in certain areas.
